description: Luxury leadership is a lifestyle and requires investment. #investinyourself #selflove #luxuryleadership
transcript: Luxury leadership is a lifestyle and it is not for everyone. Not everyone wants to work seven days a week. Not everyone wants to get up at 4 a.m. Not everyone wants to go to therapy multiple times a week. Luxury leadership has taught me that in everything that I do, I have to focus on the details because the details and the small steps matter. I do not think too far ahead because there are different variables. I do not get to control what the external world presents to me, but I control the way in which I react and I respond. Luxury leadership has taught me to stand still, but also stand firm. Sometimes we go through different changes and we are required to invest in the necessary tools to get us forward.
